name: The Butcher's Cleaver
lore: Lazarus led the men of Tristram down to find their prince.|The cleaver did not need to last. Neither did they.

name: The Undead Crown
lore: The warmth of life has entered my tomb.|- King Leoric

name: Empyrean Band
lore: The Heaven Stone gave sight beyond a man's.|Griswold set its pieces in a silver ring|that his father left him.

name: Optic Amulet
lore: The damned in the Halls of the Blind|left all of their light behind.

name: Ring of Truth
lore: Please take this ring - perhaps it|will aid you in the destruction|of such vile creatures.|- Pepin the Healer

name: Harlequin Crest
lore: This cap was left in one of the rooms by a magician|who stayed here some time ago. Perhaps it may be|of some value to you.|- Ogden of the Rising Sun

name: Veil of Steel
lore: On the journey I am about to take I will|have little use for it. May it protect you|against the dark powers below.|- Lachdanan, Captain of Leoric's Knights

name: Arkaine's Valor
lore: Arkaine turned the tide of the Sin War.|Locked away in the dark, Valor waits to turn blows again.

name: Griswold's Edge
lore: Griswold's hammer, the Hellforge's anvil.|The fire is his. The hunger is not.

name: Bovine Plate
lore: The whole adventurer motif|is just so... retro.|- Complete Nut

name: Lightforge
lore: Some armor is made to hide in.|This was made to be seen.

name: The Rift Bow
lore: Every arrow it looses arrives.|It is only a question of when.

name: The Needler
lore: A thousand pinpricks dig a grave as deep as any axe.

name: The Celestial Bow
lore: Heaven asks no strength of those it arms,|only that they aim at Hell.

name: Deadly Hunter
lore: The Horadrim became adept at hunting|demons, and made many dark enemies|in the underworlds.

name: Bow of the Dead
lore: Strung with sinew, cold and gray,|It takes a little life each day.

name: The Blackoak Bow
lore: Black oak grows only where the light|has given up.

name: Flamedart
lore: Fire is the only messenger that never|comes back with an answer.

name: Fleshstinger
lore: Made to sting, not to last.|Few things in Tristram are.

name: Windforce
lore: Too stiff for most to draw,|too strong for most to stand.|Even a Sister of the Sightless Eye|would want a steady hand.

name: Eaglehorn
lore: The eagle does not miss twice. It never needs to.

name: Gonnagal's Dirk
lore: A short blade forgives a clumsy hand.|It only asks to be quick.

name: The Defender
lore: Those who guard themselves first|strike second, if at all.

name: Gryphon's Claw
lore: A claw has no need of grace.

name: Black Razor
lore: The greatest power is often|the shortest lived.|- Adria the Witch

name: Gibbous Moon
lore: No moon is ever full over Tristram.|Something always takes a bite.

name: Ice Shank
lore: Cold steel cares nothing for fire|and very little for its own edge.

name: The Executioner's Blade
lore: My blade sings for your blood, mortal,|and by my dark masters it shall not be denied.|- The Warlord of Blood

name: The Bonesaw
lore: As long as you don't need anything reattached,|old Pepin is as good as they come.|- Wirt

name: Shadowhawk
lore: The hawk that hunts where light is thin|Drinks deep before the dawn comes in.

name: Wizardspike
lore: The wise keep a knife among their books.|Some arguments end faster that way.

name: Lightsabre
lore: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.|This blade disagrees.

name: The Falcon's Talon
lore: The falcon never strikes hard. It strikes again.

name: Inferno
lore: Light a fire in the dark and you will see|everything that comes to it.

name: Doombringer
lore: A map of the stars marked the hour|of Diablo's rising. Some doom is written|in the sky. Some is carried by hand.

name: The Grizzly
lore: The bear does not argue. It moves you.

name: The Grandfather
lore: Old enough to have forgotten|that it needs two hands.

name: The Mangler
lore: Some weapons kill cleanly.|This one kills completely.

name: Sharp Beak
lore: The crows of Tristram have never eaten so well.

name: BloodSlayer
lore: Look how it cleaves the air, and then imagine|a nice fat demon head in its path.|- Griswold the Blacksmith

name: The Celestial Axe
lore: Light in the hand, and the arm pays for it later.

name: Wicked Axe
lore: Wicked haft and wicked blade,|Neither broken nor afraid.

name: Stonecleaver
lore: Gargoyles rest as stone until the living pass.|It does not wait for them to wake.

name: Aguinara's Hatchet
lore: Spells part around it|like water around a stone.

name: Hellslayer
lore: Hell has its own smiths. It never expected ours.

name: Messerschmidt's Reaver
lore: Reapers take a tithe of every harvest.|The Reaver begins with its own.

name: Crackrust
lore: Oh, I don't care what Griswold says,|they can't make anything like they used to|in the old days...|- Farnham the Drunk

name: Hammer of Jholm
lore: The hands that swung it are dust.|It means to outlive yours too.

name: Civerb's Cudgel
lore: A demon's skull is thick.|So is the one swinging the cudgel.

name: The Celestial Star
lore: Heaven's star on an iron chain|Lights the dark and leaves a stain.

name: Baranar's Star
lore: Spikes on a ball on a stick.|Some ideas need no improving.

name: Gnarled Root
lore: This too good for you. Very Powerful!|You want - you take!|- Gharbad the Weak

name: The Cranium Basher
lore: You can cut the flesh,|but you must crush the bone.

name: Schaefer's Hammer
lore: The hammer barely bruises.|The storm inside it does the rest.

name: Dreamflange
lore: Before the darkness took it, the Cathedral|was a place of great learning.|Some lessons were blunter than others.

name: Staff of Shadows
lore: Shadows do not think. They only reach.

name: Immolator
lore: Though the heat of the sun is beyond measure,|the mere flame of a candle is of greater danger.|- Adria the Witch

name: Storm Spire
lore: Stand it on a hill in the rain,|And you won't need to stand again.

name: Gleamsong
lore: It sings, and you are gone from sight,|Somewhere near, though rarely right.

name: Thundercall
lore: Call the thunder, and be sure|you are not standing where it lands.

name: The Protector
lore: Strike me if you must.|I will not be the only one who bleeds.

name: Naj's Puzzler
lore: Its riddle has but one answer: be elsewhere.|Adria asks gold to refill it. The staff asks for blood.

name: Mindcry
lore: All these interruptions are enough|to make one insane.|- Zhar the Mad

name: Rod of Onan
lore: Rise, servant. Ask nothing,|want nothing, fear nothing.

name: Helm of Spirits
lore: The dead are always thirsty.

name: Thinking Cap
lore: Great thoughts are fragile things.|So is the cap that holds them.

name: OverLord's Helm
lore: Command needs a strong arm, not a thinking head.

name: Fool's Crest
lore: Fools outlive the wise and learn nothing from it.

name: Gotterdamerung
lore: In the Dark Exile the Lesser Evils|cast down the Three Prime Evils.|No power stands against everything.

name: Royal Circlet
lore: A crown sits lightly on a sane head.|Ask Tristram how rare that is.

name: Torn Flesh of Souls
lore: Stripped from the souls of the damned.|They no longer feel anything.|Neither, quite, will you.

name: The Gladiator's Bane
lore: The crowd cheers for the blow,|never for the armor that turned it.

name: The Rainbow Cloak
lore: Red and blue and green and gold,|A little warmth against the cold.

name: Leather of Aut
lore: Good leather never wears out. Its owners do.

name: Wisdom's Wrap
lore: Wisdom is earned, not given.|- Adria the Witch

name: Sparking Mail
lore: Many have laid a hand on its wearer.|None of them did it twice.

name: Scavenger Carapace
lore: Full of holes, it still stops a blow,|if the blow is kind enough to find it.

name: Nightscape
lore: Put out the lamp. We are safer in the dark.

name: Naj's Light Plate
lore: Plate as light as a robe,|for those who read more than they lift.

name: Demonspike Coat
lore: Fight Hell long enough|and you begin to dress like it.

name: The Deflector
lore: Every blow turned aside|is a blow that was not struck.

name: Split Skull Shield
lore: It was named for its last owner.

name: Dragon's Breach
lore: Dragon fire has broken castle walls.|It has not broken this.

name: Blackoak Shield
lore: Black oak is hard to cut|and harder still to live beside.

name: Holy Defender
lore: Leoric's Knights and Priests tried to calm|their King, and were forced to kill him.|Faith is a shield. It is not a cure.

name: Stormshield
lore: Behind it, the storm is only weather.

name: Bramble
lore: Grasp the bramble and it grasps you back.

name: Ring of Regha
lore: The learned grow pale and thin.|They call it a fair trade.

name: The Bleeder
lore: A drop for every spell it feeds,|And so the wearer always bleeds.

name: Constricting Ring
lore: It keeps out everything. Even the breath.

name: Ring of Engagement
lore: I will stand by you,|and hurt anyone who comes too close.

name: Giant's Knuckle
lore: Listen, listen... here's the secret -|moderation is the key!|- Farnham the Drunk

name: Mercurial Ring
lore: Quicksilver slips through every grasp,|its own included.

name: Xorine's Ring
lore: Knowledge is power. It is not, however, strength.

name: Karik's Ring
lore: The ox outlives the scholar, and never wonders why.

name: Ring of Magma
lore: Stand in the fire long enough|and you forget every other danger.

name: Ring of the Mystics
lore: Mystics guard their minds against every spell,|and forget they have bodies.

name: Ring of Thunder
lore: Let the storm come. Pray nothing else does.

name: Amulet of Warding
lore: The one who trapped Na-Krul warded him|behind great walls. The wards held.|Their maker did not.

name: Gnat Sting
lore: The Defiler swore its brood would overrun|the fields that men call home. Each one|is small. That was never the point.

name: Flambeau
lore: No arrow leaves this bow. Only the fire does.

name: Armor of Gloom
lore: The crypts are full of shadows that move|just beyond the corners of my vision.

name: Blitzen
lore: The string sings, the sky answers,|and the quiver stays full.

name: Thunderclap
lore: The hammer falls, the thunder rolls,|And the Labyrinth counts its souls.

name: Shirotachi
lore: Armor is only a suggestion. The blade declines it.

name: Eater of Souls
lore: Diablo's faithful hail him as the Destroyer of Souls.|This blade is less wasteful. It eats them,|and when none are near, it eats yours.

name: Diamondedge
lore: Look at that edge, that balance.|A sword in the right hands, and against|the right foe, is the master of all weapons.|- Griswold the Blacksmith

name: Bone Chain Armor
lore: In the Chamber of Bone, those who died|stealing its treasure were bound to guard it.|The dead are slow to strike their own.

name: Demon Plate Armor
lore: Demons know the smell of their own kind.|It buys a moment's doubt.

name: Acolyte's Amulet
lore: The acolyte's first lesson:|the spirit pays what the body owes.

name: Gladiator's Ring
lore: Every spell is paid for in blood.|The ring only keeps the books.

name: Ashen Covenant
lore: Ash keeps every promise fire makes.

name: Silver Argument
lore: Silver settles arguments with men.|Fire settles them with everything else.

name: Bell of Ruin
lore: Ring for the wedding, ring for the dead,|Ring for the fire and the roof overhead.

name: Gravetimber
lore: Leoric's executions left Tristram|with a great deal of gallows wood. It burns well.

name: Dawn Severance
lore: Dawn does not come below the Cathedral.|Carry your own.

name: Cathedral Bell
lore: It called Tristram in to pray for the dead.|It rings in fire now, and the cold has fled.

name: Whisperknife
lore: Hush now. The smoke will tell them.

name: Red Talon
lore: Whatever crawls up from the Burning Hells|brings a little of the heat with it.

name: Long Hunt
lore: A long hunt ends at the cookfire,|one way or the other.

name: Sevenfold Path
lore: The Zakarum light their way with candles,|and with whatever else will burn.

name: Chain of Contrition
lore: Penance is cleanest by fire.|Ask any heretic.

name: Raincaller
lore: It was named for the rain it called down.|The rain was burning.

name: Iron Rebuttal
lore: Hot goods, no refunds,|and you never saw me.|- Wirt the Peg-legged boy

name: Red Harvest
lore: Reapers work fastest at the end of the season.

name: The Quiet Verdict
lore: The condemned have nothing left to lose,|and so nothing left to miss.

name: Saintbreaker
lore: A martyr does not mend, and does not stop.

name: World Rend
lore: The world is ending.|There is no sense in pacing yourself.

name: The Long Memory
lore: The Butcher's wounds would not close,|and the men who bore them stopped wanting them to.

name: Earth's Complaint
lore: The ground takes everyone eventually.|It is in no hurry. You should be.

name: Black Letter
lore: Every name on the black letter was already dead.|Some of them had not been told yet.

name: Hunger's Hand
lore: A starving hand does not tremble.

name: Skyspike
lore: Fall if you must. Strike first.

name: Wind Through Reeds
lore: Bent the reed, and thin, and worn,|It whistles loudest when it's torn.

name: Morning Prayer
lore: Pray at dawn, fight at noon,|and be buried before supper.

name: The Unblinking Moon
lore: The moon never blinks at the dying.|Neither should you.

name: The Long Answer
lore: The short answer is no. The long answer|takes longer, and it does not miss.

name: Wolfsplitter
lore: A wolf is killed with one good blow, or not at all.

name: Vigil of Glass
lore: Glass keeps the candle lit|and cuts the hand that reaches in.

name: The Final Word
lore: Speak rarely, and make it count.

name: The Red Orchard
lore: Prune once, and prune deep.|The tree will weep for days.

name: Royal Exile
lore: An exile gets one chance to come home.|He spends it carefully.

name: The Penitent
lore: Penitents strike rarely, but never gently.

name: The Last Secret
lore: Lean close. This is the only time|I will tell you.

name: Beast Within
lore: Every man has a beast within. It does not nibble.

name: Pilgrim's Reach
lore: Tristram was a frequent stop for travelers, once.|Now the road ends at the Cathedral door.

name: Temple Echo
lore: In an empty temple, a single word|is heard long after it is spoken.

name: The Penitent Star
lore: Seldom falls the penitent star,|But where it lands, it leaves a scar.

name: Deadeye's Debt
lore: A deadeye's debts are paid in full, or not at all.

name: Siege Psalm
lore: A siege is mostly waiting. Then it is mostly blood.

name: Oath of Bark
lore: Bark grows thick where it is struck.|The oak was never going anywhere.

name: Kingsfall Edge
lore: Leoric's knights stood firm around their King|until standing firm meant striking him down.|They are standing still.

name: Griefhammer
lore: Grief slows the feet and strengthens the arm.

name: Executioner's Moon
lore: In the year of the King's madness,|the headsman never had to walk far.

name: Last Banner
lore: You kill uglies, get banner.|You bring to me, or else...|- Snotspill

name: Mountain's Due
lore: Mountains do not hurry, and they are never late.

name: Needle of Hours
lore: Hours pass slowly in the Labyrinth,|and each one leaves you a little harder.

name: Skinripper
lore: Thick skin is grown, not bought,|and every blow pays for a little more.

name: The First Charge
lore: Khanduras marched on Westmarch under many banners.|Few came home, and none of them quickly.

name: Empty Palm
lore: An empty palm can catch a falling blow.|A full one cannot.

name: Censer of Ash
lore: With every rite the censer grows heavier,|and the priest who swings it, slower.

name: Green Silence
lore: Forests stand still|and let their enemies come to them.

name: Black Powder Gospel
lore: The gospel is heavy, and so is the bow.|Both persuade whoever stands in front of them.

name: The Last Hatchet
lore: Chop, chop, the woodsman's song.|Chop, and something answers wrong.

name: Second Sunrise
lore: Those who came back from below swore|the sunrise was never the same colour twice.

name: Pilgrim's Burden
lore: The pilgrim's load is mostly stone,|until the sky decides to add to it.

name: Root of War
lore: The Sin War put its roots down deep,|and they still drink from every field.

name: Heaven's Scar
lore: The High Heavens and the Burning Hells|leave the same mark on mortal ground.

name: Ashen Colossus
lore: A big hammer is patient.|It saves its temper for the right moment.

name: Quietus
lore: Most knives whisper.|This one, every so often, screams.

name: The Ninth Claw
lore: The hounds of the Labyrinth hunt in packs,|and one in every pack breathes something worse.

name: Sunpiercer's Oath
lore: Pierce the sky often enough|and something will fall out.

name: Wheel of Hours
lore: Fire at morning, frost at noon,|Storm by night beneath the moon.|Turn the wheel and wait your hour,|Every turn a different power.

name: Martyr's Orbit
lore: Swing long enough and the heavens|will take an interest.

name: Stormstring
lore: Loose, and loose again.|Then wait for the thunder.

name: Final Bolt
lore: Most bolts are loosed at whoever is there.|This one is saved for someone in particular.

name: Gorewake
lore: Slow it rises, slow it falls,|Then twice it rings along the walls.

name: Mercy's End
lore: Mercy is given once.|After that, the blade is given twice.

name: Stone Gospel
lore: The Zakarum carved their gospel in stone|so it would outlast the faithful. It has.

name: Sundering Hymn
lore: Deep the hymn and slow the tone,|The chorus sings itself alone.

name: Oathbreaker
lore: An oath breaks slowly, and then all at once.

name: Final Toll
lore: No one hurries the last bell.|It always rings again.

name: Widow's Promise
lore: I will be patient.|I will come back for the rest of you.

name: Predator's Due
lore: The patient beast is owed,|and it collects with interest.

name: Far Horizon
lore: Walk far enough and the road comes round again.

name: Last Discipline
lore: Discipline is the same blow,|struck until it strikes itself.

name: Judgement Swings
lore: Judgement is slow.|Then it comes back to make sure.

name: Last Flight
lore: Draw it slow and let it fly,|And then another, quick and sly.

name: Dragon's Argument
lore: Never argue with a dragon.|It has the last word, and then it has it again.

name: Glass Thought
lore: A full mind cuts deepest and empties fastest.

name: Worldroot
lore: Deep roots drink deep,|and the tree is always thirsty.

name: Saint's Debt
lore: Every miracle is paid for.|The saints simply never asked the price.

name: Eye of the Deep
lore: Tristram's water comes from a spring far below.|What lives down there wants paying by the bucket.

name: The Third Question
lore: Hello, my friend.|Stay awhile and listen...|- Deckard Cain

name: The Ninth Circle
lore: The old mages drew their circles slowly|and never stepped outside them mid-sentence.

name: Crownless King
lore: A seated king is obeyed twice over.|A king on the road is merely followed.

name: The Still Point
lore: Stand still, and the world turns for you.|Run, and you turn with it.

name: Embermind
lore: First the ember, then the frost,|Then the storm, and none is lost.

name: Pilgrim of Stars
lore: The stars keep to their order.|The pilgrim who keeps to it arrives.

name: Choir of Ash
lore: Each voice waits its turn in the choir.|The one who sings out of turn sings badly.

name: Glass Orbit
lore: Flame and frost and storm in turn,|Wait your place, or you will burn.

name: Cold Logic
lore: Cold logic burns the walls for warmth|and calls the larder saved.

name: Winter's Argument
lore: Winter argues that the woodpile|is for burning, not for hiding behind.

name: The Quiet Throne
lore: Khanduras spent its knights to keep its throne,|and had none left to stand at the door.

name: Thought Vessel
lore: Pour from the jar that protects you|and it will not fill again on its own.

name: Storm Thesis
lore: Learn one lesson well.|The storm will not wait for a second.

name: Ashen Thesis
lore: The scholar learned fire from the ashes|of those who studied it before him.

name: Sunbound
lore: Stare at the sun|and for a while you will see nothing else.

name: The Quiet Star
lore: A star knows one road and never forgets the way.

name: The Empty Word
lore: An empty word said over and over|is still a word, and still empty.

name: Crown of Branches
lore: Trees grow best in graveyards.

name: Reliquary of Breath
lore: Collect enough last breaths|and you can sing with them.

name: Memory Well
lore: Drop enough deaths into a well|and the well begins to talk back.

name: The Remembered Face
lore: Its visor stayed shut so long|the wearer forgot how to duck.

name: Second Skin
lore: You won't be stepping out of the way in this.|You won't need to.|- Griswold the Blacksmith

name: Last Door
lore: Flame, frost and storm all knock at the last door.|It does not answer, and it does not move.

name: Crown of Cinders
lore: Step aside from the incantation|and you never have to learn its name.

name: Cathedral of Bone
lore: In the Chamber of Bone the dead keep watch forever.|They never learned to step aside.

name: The Unbroken Wall
lore: The wall was never broken.|It was never there when they swung.

name: The Unseen Eye
lore: What heals the body may mend the veil.|Nothing else will.

name: The Long Vigil
lore: Pepin sat with the wounded through the night.|In Tristram, nothing mends by itself.

name: Saint's Bulwark
lore: Saints do not mend themselves. Someone has to pray.

name: Helm of the Last Guard
lore: The last sentry sets the bar a little lower|so he can clear it with room to spare.

name: Heart of Iron
lore: An iron heart lets nothing in|and keeps whatever spills over.

name: Mirror of Dust
lore: The mirror no longer shows a face,|only what has piled on top of it.

name: Thoughtcage
lore: A mind is safest in a cage it never leaves.

name: Ghostweave
lore: The cursed dead of the Cathedral never wander.|It is why they have lasted so long.

name: Gatekeeper
lore: You may pass when I move. I do not move.

name: Mask of Returning
lore: Please, don't kill me,|just hear me out.|- Lachdanan, Captain of Leoric's Knights

name: The Last Bastion
lore: The last bastion does not wait for relief.|It is the relief.

name: Promise of Stone
lore: Stone does not drink potions.|It simply refuses to stay broken.

name: Circle of Ash
lore: Walk through fire long enough|and you begin to enjoy it.

name: The Other Half
lore: Give the mind a shell,|and the body grows thin to pay for it.

name: Debt of Kings
lore: Kings pay their debts in one great sum|and hurry off before the next falls due.

name: Closed Circuit
lore: The strong arm carries the weak one,|at least halfway.

name: The Long Promise
lore: Keep alive and next time|good bring to you.|- Gharbad the Weak

name: Nothing Ends
lore: Nothing ends. It only passes to the other hand.

name: Voice of the Fallen
lore: The fallen speak loudest of the thing they did best.

name: The Inner Sun
lore: Keep a little light back for yourself.|The world will ask for all of it.

name: Chain of Names
lore: The Horadrim wrote down every name.|I am all that is left of the list.|- Deckard Cain

name: Hourglass Heart
lore: A heart that does not sicken|does not stagger either.

name: Astral Debt
lore: Borrowing from the stars is easy.|They are very patient creditors.

name: Cinder Crown
lore: The Madburner never learned where the fire ended|and he began.

name: Furnace Oath
lore: Those who swear by the furnace|are not surprised to be burned by it.

name: Ashen Circle
lore: Hand to hand the embers go,|And come back to the hand they know.

name: Mother's Veil
lore: When one of Leoric's dead falls,|the rest grow angrier, and the fallen get up.

name: Bone Choir
lore: A voice falls silent, the choir swells,|The dead return to ring the bells.|Sing them down and sing them round,|They will not stay beneath the ground.

name: Cradle of Teeth
lore: Prepare yourself, mortal,|to serve my Master for eternity!|- King Leoric

name: Iron Testament
lore: The Butcher was never quick.|He never needed to be.

name: Hammer of Saints
lore: Ah... fresh meat!|- The Butcher

name: Tyrant's Spark
lore: Stormbane rode the lightning so long|it forgot whose side he was on.

name: Winterstring
lore: Nightwing the Cold kept the winter in its wings|and spent it all at once.

name: Clockface
lore: The Warlord has known only war for an age.|He has learned to measure every cut twice.

name: Final Verdict
lore: My blade sings for your blood, mortal,|and by my dark masters it shall not be denied.|- Warlord of Blood

name: Second Hand
lore: The Executioner of Hell keeps time by his victims.|He has never once been late.

name: Thornheart
lore: Ah, I can smell you... you are close! Close!|Ssss... the scent of blood and fear...|- The Defiler

name: Red Briar
lore: The Defiler swore its tendrils would cover|the fields of men. It began with Lester's orchard.

name: Crown Without Dawn
lore: Lazarus preached holy retribution from afar.|When the hellspawn came close, he ran deeper.

name: Nightglass
lore: Abandon your foolish quest. All that awaits you|is the wrath of my Master!|- Archbishop Lazarus

name: Sunless Seal
lore: Once the King's most trusted advisor,|Lazarus kept the darkest counsel of all.

name: Oracle's Lens
lore: Zhar the Mad read the same page again and again|until it read him back.

name: Glass Thesis
lore: All these interruptions are enough|to make one insane.|- Zhar the Mad

name: Prophecy Unmade
lore: Zhar saw every ending coming|except the one that knocked.

name: Colossus Hide
lore: Great walls were raised to hold Na-Krul.|He wears them now, and walks a little slower.

name: Worldhammer
lore: From the Void, Na-Krul rages against the one|who sent him there, and the walls shake.

name: Hunger Eternal
lore: The Lord of Terror woke weak from his long sleep.|He took a king's mind and a prince's body,|and he is hungry still.

name: Empty Cup
lore: Drink from every cup at once|and you will thirst all the sooner.

name: Red Mercy
lore: Some of it works at once.|The rest will catch up with you.|- Pepin the Healer

name: Last Draught
lore: Drink up. Whatever you can't hold|will keep you standing anyway.|- Ogden of the Rising Sun

name: Saint's Blood
lore: Saint's blood is thicker than the common kind,|and more of it is drunk than was ever bled.

name: Borrowed Breath
lore: Borrow only when you are drowning.|The lender insists.

name: The Long Recovery
lore: Mending goes easier with company.

name: Heartglass
lore: Glass breaks so the heart does not.

name: God's Last Breath
lore: The Horadrim held the Lord of Terror in stone.|This holds only his last breath.

name: Blue Silence
lore: Silence fills a mind faster than any word.

name: Scholar's Reserve
lore: Cain has read more than any mind should hold.|The rest spills over into his stories.

name: Deep Well
lore: Listen, listen... here's the secret.|Moderation is the key!|- Farnham the Drunk

name: Borrowed Thought
lore: Ideas come easiest|to those who have run out of them.

name: The Last Idea
lore: The last idea in the room|is the one everyone shares.

name: Moonwater
lore: Moonwater for the hidden skin,|But not a drop for blood within.

name: Little Guardian
lore: My grandmother says it keeps the fire away,|even after you take it off.|- Gillian the Barmaid

name: The Second Bell
lore: The second bell rings for the dead,|and the dead do not pay the ringer.

name: Quiet Ward
lore: A quiet prayer covers more people than a loud one.

name: Witchglass
lore: Look into the glass, but only briefly.|What looks back will lend you its teeth.|- Adria the Witch

name: Saint's Token
lore: Pray with empty hands, and still|The saint will answer, when he will.

name: The Last Warning
lore: Get up. I will not say it again.

name: Frozen Step
lore: Where Bluehorn walked, the cold stayed behind,|waiting for someone to step in it.
